<h3 id="create-a-transaction-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|expand|query|string|false|Expand a response to get a full related object included inside of the `_embedded` path in the response.<br>It accepts a comma-separated list of objects to expand.<br>See the [expand guide](https://api-reference.rebilly.com/#section/Expand-to-include-embedded-objects) for more info.<br>|
|Organization-Id|header|[ResourceId](#schemaresourceid)|false|Organization identifier in scope of which need to perform request (if not specified, the default organization will be used).|
|body|body|[TransactionRequest](#schematransactionrequest)|true|Transaction resource.|
|» amount|body|number(double)|true|The transaction amount.|
|» billingAddress|body|object \| null|false|Billing address. If not supplied, we use the billing address associated with the payment instrument, and then customer.|
|» » address|body|string \| null|false|The contact street address.|
|» » address2|body|string \| null|false|The contact street address (second line).|
|» » city|body|string \| null|false|The contact city.|
|» » country|body|string \| null|false|The contact country ISO Alpha-2 code.|
|» » emails|body|[ContactEmails](#schemacontactemails)|false|The list of emails.|
|» » firstName|body|string \| null|false|The contact first name.|
|» » lastName|body|string \| null|false|The contact last name.|
|» » organization|body|string \| null|false|The contact organization.|
|» » phoneNumbers|body|[ContactPhoneNumbers](#schemacontactphonenumbers)|false|The list of phone numbers.|
|» » postalCode|body|string \| null|false|The contact postal code.|
|» » region|body|string \| null|false|The contact region (state).|
|» currency|body|object|true|none|
|» customFields|body|[ResourceCustomFields](#schemaresourcecustomfields)|false|Custom Fields list as a map `{"custom field name": "custom field value", ...}`. The format must follow the saved format (see Custom Fields section for the formats).<br>|
|» customerId|body|object|true|The customer identifier string.|
|» description|body|string \| null|false|The payment description.|
|» gatewayAccountId|body|object \| null|false|Rebilly will select the appropriate payment gateway account for the transaction based on the properties of the transaction and the `gateway-account-requested` event rules configurations. If you wish to prevent Rebilly from making the gateway account selection, you may supply a gateway account id here, and it will be used instead. Only use this field if you intend to override the settings.|
|» invoiceIds|body|[[ResourceId](#schemaresourceid)]|false|The array of invoice identifiers.|
|» isMerchantInitiated|body|boolean|false|True if the transaction was initiated by the merchant.|
|» isProcessedOutside|body|boolean|false|True if transaction was processed outside Rebilly.|
|» notificationUrl|body|string(uri) \| null|false|The URL where a server-to-server notification request type `POST` with a transaction payload will be sent when the transaction's result is finalized. Do not trust the notification; follow with a `GET` request to confirm the result of the transaction. Please respond with a `2xx` HTTP status code, or we will reattempt the request again. You may use `{id}` or `{result}` as placeholders in the URL and we will replace them with the transaction's id and result accordingly.<br>|
|» paymentInstruction|body|object|false|Payment instruction. If not supplied, customer's default payment instrument will be used.|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[PaymentToken](#schemapaymenttoken)|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[PaymentInstrument-3](#schemapaymentinstrument-3)|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[PaymentMethods](#schemapaymentmethods)|false|none|
|» paymentInstrument|body|object|false|**Deprecated.**|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[VaultedInstrument](#schemavaultedinstrument)|false|Vaulted payment instrument.|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[AlternativePaymentInstrument](#schemaalternativepaymentinstrument)|false|Alternative payment method instrument.|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[CashInstrument](#schemacashinstrument)|false|Cash payment instrument object.|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[CheckInstrument](#schemacheckinstrument)|false|Check payment instrument object.|
|» processedTime|body|string(date-time)|false|The time the transaction was processed. Can be specified only if transaction was processed outside Rebilly.|
|» redirectUrl|body|string(uri) \| null|false|The URL to redirect the end-user when an offsite transaction is completed. Defaults to the website's configured URL. You may use `{id}` or `{result}` as placeholders in the URL and we will replace them with the transaction's id and result accordingly.|
|» requestId|body|string \| null|false|The request id is **recommended**. It prevents duplicate transaction requests within a short period of time. If a duplicate request is sent with the same `requestId` it will be ignored to prevent double-billing anyone.  It must be unique within a 24-hour period.  We recommend generating a UUID v4 as its value.|
|» riskMetadata|body|[RiskMetadata](#schemariskmetadata)|false|Risk metadata used for 3DS and risk scoring.|
|» websiteId|body|object|true|The website identifier string.|
|» type|body|string|true|The type of transaction requested.<br>You should always include the type within your API request.<br>This supports a limited subset of Transaction types.  To refund or void, use the refund endpoint.<br>To `capture` use the `sale` type. If any existing `authorize` transactions are eligible, then they will be captured and the `sale` will be converted to a `capture` type.<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» type|3ds-authentication|
|» type|sale|
|» type|authorize|

## Retrieve a Transaction

<a id="opIdGetTransaction"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/transactions/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "REB-APIKEY: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /transactions/{id}`

Retrieve a Transaction with specified identifier string.


<h3 id="retrieve-a-transaction-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|expand|query|string|false|Expand a response to get a full related object included inside of the `_embedded` path in the response.<br>It accepts a comma-separated list of objects to expand.<br>See the [expand guide](https://api-reference.rebilly.com/#section/Expand-to-include-embedded-objects) for more info.<br>|
|id|path|string|true|The resource identifier string.|
|Organization-Id|header|[ResourceId](#schemaresourceid)|false|Organization identifier in scope of which need to perform request (if not specified, the default organization will be used).|

|---|---|---|---|---|

## Update a transaction

<a id="opIdPatchTransaction"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/transactions/string \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "REB-APIKEY: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "customFields": {
      "foo": "bar"
    }
  }'
```

`PATCH /transactions/{id}`

Update a transaction's custom fields.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "customFields": {
    "foo": "bar"
  }
}
```

|body|body|object|true|Use the patch transaction request to modify custom fields.|
|» customFields|body|[ResourceCustomFields](#schemaresourcecustomfields)|false|Custom Fields list as a map `{"custom field name": "custom field value", ...}`. The format must follow the saved format (see Custom Fields section for the formats).<br>|

## Query a Transaction

<a id="opIdPostTransactionQuery"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/transactions/string/query \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "REB-APIKEY: ${API_KEY}"
```

`POST /transactions/{id}/query`

Query a Transaction with a specified identifier string.
The query will contact the gateway account to find the result and amount/currency.
The response should be analyzed.  If deemed appropriate, the transaction could be updated using the Transaction Update API.


<h3 id="query-a-transaction-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|id|path|string|true|The resource identifier string.|

## Refund a Transaction

<a id="opIdPostTransactionRefund"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/transactions/string/refund \

}

A1Gateway config.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|_links|[[SelfLink](#schemaselflink) \| [OnBoardingUrlLink](#schemaonboardingurllink) \| [DynamicIpnLink](#schemadynamicipnlink) \| [StaticIpnLink](#schemastaticipnlink)]|false|read-only|The links related to resource.|
|acceptedCurrencies|[string]|true|none|Accepted currencies (array of the currency three letter codes).|
|acquirerName|object|false|none|none|
|additionalFilters|string|false|none|The additional filters are used to determine whether the gateway account can be selected for the transaction to be processed.<br>For example, the filter may put a maximum amount value. If the transaction is above that amount, this gateway account wouldn't be used.<br>This follows our standard filter format.<br>|
|approvalWindowTtl|integer|false|none|The time window (in seconds) allotted for approving an offsite transaction before it is automatically `abandoned`.|
|cityField|string|false|none|The gateway account's city field (also known as line 2 descriptor).|
|createdTime|object|false|none|Gateway Account created time.|
|dccForceCurrency|string|false|none|Force dynamic currency conversion to the specified currency on each sale.<br>Leave it empty to disable force DCC.<br>|
|dccMarkup|integer|false|none|Dynamic currency conversion markup in basis points.|
|descriptor|string|false|none|The gateway account's descriptor.|
|digitalWallets|[DigitalWallets](#schemadigitalwallets)|false|none|Configure which digital wallets are enabled.|
|dynamicDescriptor|boolean|false|none|True, if Gateway Account allows dynamic descriptor.|
|excludedDccQuoteCurrencies|[string]|false|none|Excluded Dynamic Currency Conversion Quote Currencies.|
|gatewayName|[GatewayName](#schemagatewayname)|true|none|The payment gateway name.|
|id|object|false|read-only|The gateway identifier string.|
|isDown|boolean|false|read-only|True if gateway is currently in downtime period.|
|merchantCategoryCode|string|false|none|The gateway account's merchant category code.|
|method|[PaymentMethod](#schemapaymentmethod)|true|none|The payment method.|
|monthlyLimit|number(double)|false|none|Monthly Limit.|
|organizationId|object|false|read-only|**Deprecated.** Organization ID.|
|paymentCardSchemes|[[PaymentCardBrand](#schemapaymentcardbrand)]|false|none|Accepted payment card brands.|
|reconciliationWindowEnabled|boolean|false|none|If a transaction is not reconciled within the `reconciliationWindowTtl` time, then the transaction is marked as `abandoned`.|
|reconciliationWindowTtl|integer|false|none|The time window (in seconds) allotted for a reconciliation to occur. If it is not reconciled in that time, then the transaction is marked as `abandoned`.|
|status|string|false|read-only|The gateway account's status.|
|sticky|boolean|false|none|Customer's payment instrument will "stick" to the gateway account for future transactions when enabled.|

Airpay config.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|_links|[[SelfLink](#schemaselflink) \| [OnBoardingUrlLink](#schemaonboardingurllink) \| [DynamicIpnLink](#schemadynamicipnlink) \| [StaticIpnLink](#schemastaticipnlink)]|false|read-only|The links related to resource.|
|acceptedCurrencies|[string]|true|none|Accepted currencies (array of the currency three letter codes).|
|acquirerName|object|false|none|none|
|additionalFilters|string|false|none|The additional filters are used to determine whether the gateway account can be selected for the transaction to be processed.<br>For example, the filter may put a maximum amount value. If the transaction is above that amount, this gateway account wouldn't be used.<br>This follows our standard filter format.<br>|
|approvalWindowTtl|integer|false|none|The time window (in seconds) allotted for approving an offsite transaction before it is automatically `abandoned`.|
|cityField|string|false|none|The gateway account's city field (also known as line 2 descriptor).|
|createdTime|object|false|none|Gateway Account created time.|
|dccForceCurrency|string|false|none|Force dynamic currency conversion to the specified currency on each sale.<br>Leave it empty to disable force DCC.<br>|
|dccMarkup|integer|false|none|Dynamic currency conversion markup in basis points.|
|descriptor|string|false|none|The gateway account's descriptor.|
|digitalWallets|[DigitalWallets](#schemadigitalwallets)|false|none|Configure which digital wallets are enabled.|
|dynamicDescriptor|boolean|false|none|True, if Gateway Account allows dynamic descriptor.|
|excludedDccQuoteCurrencies|[string]|false|none|Excluded Dynamic Currency Conversion Quote Currencies.|
|gatewayName|[GatewayName](#schemagatewayname)|true|none|The payment gateway name.|
|id|object|false|read-only|The gateway identifier string.|
|isDown|boolean|false|read-only|True if gateway is currently in downtime period.|
|merchantCategoryCode|string|false|none|The gateway account's merchant category code.|
|method|[PaymentMethod](#schemapaymentmethod)|true|none|The payment method.|
|monthlyLimit|number(double)|false|none|Monthly Limit.|
|organizationId|object|false|read-only|**Deprecated.** Organization ID.|
|paymentCardSchemes|[[PaymentCardBrand](#schemapaymentcardbrand)]|false|none|Accepted payment card brands.|
|reconciliationWindowEnabled|boolean|false|none|If a transaction is not reconciled within the `reconciliationWindowTtl` time, then the transaction is marked as `abandoned`.|
|reconciliationWindowTtl|integer|false|none|The time window (in seconds) allotted for a reconciliation to occur. If it is not reconciled in that time, then the transaction is marked as `abandoned`.|
|status|string|false|read-only|The gateway account's status.|
|sticky|boolean|false|none|Customer's payment instrument will "stick" to the gateway account for future transactions when enabled.|
|threeDSecure|boolean|false|none|True, if Gateway Account allows 3DSecure.|
|timeout|integer \| null|false|none|Gateway Account request timeout in seconds.|
|token|string|false|read-only|Gateway Account token.|
|updatedTime|object|false|none|Gateway Account updated time.|
|credentials|object|true|none|Airpay credentials object.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|_links|[[SelfLink](#schemaselflink) \| [OnBoardingUrlLink](#schemaonboardingurllink) \| [DynamicIpnLink](#schemadynamicipnlink) \| [StaticIpnLink](#schemastaticipnlink)]|false|read-only|The links related to resource.|
|acceptedCurrencies|[string]|true|none|Accepted currencies (array of the currency three letter codes).|
|acquirerName|object|false|none|none|
|additionalFilters|string|false|none|The additional filters are used to determine whether the gateway account can be selected for the transaction to be processed.<br>For example, the filter may put a maximum amount value. If the transaction is above that amount, this gateway account wouldn't be used.<br>This follows our standard filter format.<br>|
|approvalWindowTtl|integer|false|none|The time window (in seconds) allotted for approving an offsite transaction before it is automatically `abandoned`.|
|cityField|string|false|none|The gateway account's city field (also known as line 2 descriptor).|
|createdTime|object|false|none|Gateway Account created time.|
|dccForceCurrency|string|false|none|Force dynamic currency conversion to the specified currency on each sale.<br>Leave it empty to disable force DCC.<br>|
|dccMarkup|integer|false|none|Dynamic currency conversion markup in basis points.|
|descriptor|string|false|none|The gateway account's descriptor.|
|digitalWallets|[DigitalWallets](#schemadigitalwallets)|false|none|Configure which digital wallets are enabled.|
|dynamicDescriptor|boolean|false|none|True, if Gateway Account allows dynamic descriptor.|
|excludedDccQuoteCurrencies|[string]|false|none|Excluded Dynamic Currency Conversion Quote Currencies.|
|gatewayName|[GatewayName](#schemagatewayname)|true|none|The payment gateway name.|
|id|object|false|read-only|The gateway identifier string.|
|isDown|boolean|false|read-only|True if gateway is currently in downtime period.|
|merchantCategoryCode|string|false|none|The gateway account's merchant category code.|
|method|[PaymentMethod](#schemapaymentmethod)|true|none|The payment method.|
|monthlyLimit|number(double)|false|none|Monthly Limit.|
|organizationId|object|false|read-only|**Deprecated.** Organization ID.|
|paymentCardSchemes|[[PaymentCardBrand](#schemapaymentcardbrand)]|false|none|Accepted payment card brands.|
|reconciliationWindowEnabled|boolean|false|none|If a transaction is not reconciled within the `reconciliationWindowTtl` time, then the transaction is marked as `abandoned`.|
|reconciliationWindowTtl|integer|false|none|The time window (in seconds) allotted for a reconciliation to occur. If it is not reconciled in that time, then the transaction is marked as `abandoned`.|
|status|string|false|read-only|The gateway account's status.|
|sticky|boolean|false|none|Customer's payment instrument will "stick" to the gateway account for future transactions when enabled.|
|threeDSecure|boolean|false|none|True, if Gateway Account allows 3DSecure.|
|timeout|integer \| null|false|none|Gateway Account request timeout in seconds.|
|token|string|false|read-only|Gateway Account token.|
|updatedTime|object|false|none|Gateway Account updated time.|
|credentials|object|true|none|AmexVPC credentials object.|
|settings|object|true|none|AmexVPC settings object.|

AuthorizeNet Gateway config.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|_links|[[SelfLink](#schemaselflink) \| [OnBoardingUrlLink](#schemaonboardingurllink) \| [DynamicIpnLink](#schemadynamicipnlink) \| [StaticIpnLink](#schemastaticipnlink)]|false|read-only|The links related to resource.|
|acceptedCurrencies|[string]|true|none|Accepted currencies (array of the currency three letter codes).|
|acquirerName|object|false|none|none|
|additionalFilters|string|false|none|The additional filters are used to determine whether the gateway account can be selected for the transaction to be processed.<br>For example, the filter may put a maximum amount value. If the transaction is above that amount, this gateway account wouldn't be used.<br>This follows our standard filter format.<br>|
|approvalWindowTtl|integer|false|none|The time window (in seconds) allotted for approving an offsite transaction before it is automatically `abandoned`.|
|cityField|string|false|none|The gateway account's city field (also known as line 2 descriptor).|
|createdTime|object|false|none|Gateway Account created time.|
|dccForceCurrency|string|false|none|Force dynamic currency conversion to the specified currency on each sale.<br>Leave it empty to disable force DCC.<br>|
|dccMarkup|integer|false|none|Dynamic currency conversion markup in basis points.|
|descriptor|string|false|none|The gateway account's descriptor.|
|digitalWallets|[DigitalWallets](#schemadigitalwallets)|false|none|Configure which digital wallets are enabled.|
|dynamicDescriptor|boolean|false|none|True, if Gateway Account allows dynamic descriptor.|
|excludedDccQuoteCurrencies|[string]|false|none|Excluded Dynamic Currency Conversion Quote Currencies.|
|gatewayName|[GatewayName](#schemagatewayname)|true|none|The payment gateway name.|
|id|object|false|read-only|The gateway identifier string.|
|isDown|boolean|false|read-only|True if gateway is currently in downtime period.|

|status|string|false|read-only|The gateway account's status.|
|sticky|boolean|false|none|Customer's payment instrument will "stick" to the gateway account for future transactions when enabled.|
|threeDSecure|boolean|false|none|True, if Gateway Account allows 3DSecure.|
|timeout|integer \| null|false|none|Gateway Account request timeout in seconds.|

Bambora Gateway config.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|_links|[[SelfLink](#schemaselflink) \| [OnBoardingUrlLink](#schemaonboardingurllink) \| [DynamicIpnLink](#schemadynamicipnlink) \| [StaticIpnLink](#schemastaticipnlink)]|false|read-only|The links related to resource.|
|acceptedCurrencies|[string]|true|none|Accepted currencies (array of the currency three letter codes).|
|acquirerName|object|false|none|none|
|additionalFilters|string|false|none|The additional filters are used to determine whether the gateway account can be selected for the transaction to be processed.<br>For example, the filter may put a maximum amount value. If the transaction is above that amount, this gateway account wouldn't be used.<br>This follows our standard filter format.<br>|
|approvalWindowTtl|integer|false|none|The time window (in seconds) allotted for approving an offsite transaction before it is automatically `abandoned`.|
|cityField|string|false|none|The gateway account's city field (also known as line 2 descriptor).|
|createdTime|object|false|none|Gateway Account created time.|
|dccForceCurrency|string|false|none|Force dynamic currency conversion to the specified currency on each sale.<br>Leave it empty to disable force DCC.<br>|
|dccMarkup|integer|false|none|Dynamic currency conversion markup in basis points.|
|descriptor|string|false|none|The gateway account's descriptor.|
|digitalWallets|[DigitalWallets](#schemadigitalwallets)|false|none|Configure which digital wallets are enabled.|
|dynamicDescriptor|boolean|false|none|True, if Gateway Account allows dynamic descriptor.|
|excludedDccQuoteCurrencies|[string]|false|none|Excluded Dynamic Currency Conversion Quote Currencies.|
|gatewayName|[GatewayName](#schemagatewayname)|true|none|The payment gateway name.|
|id|object|false|read-only|The gateway identifier string.|
|isDown|boolean|false|read-only|True if gateway is currently in downtime period.|
|merchantCategoryCode|string|false|none|The gateway account's merchant category code.|
|method|[PaymentMethod](#schemapaymentmethod)|true|none|The payment method.|
|monthlyLimit|number(double)|false|none|Monthly Limit.|
|organizationId|object|false|read-only|**Deprecated.** Organization ID.|
|paymentCardSchemes|[[PaymentCardBrand](#schemapaymentcardbrand)]|false|none|Accepted payment card brands.|
|reconciliationWindowEnabled|boolean|false|none|If a transaction is not reconciled within the `reconciliationWindowTtl` time, then the transaction is marked as `abandoned`.|
|reconciliationWindowTtl|integer|false|none|The time window (in seconds) allotted for a reconciliation to occur. If it is not reconciled in that time, then the transaction is marked as `abandoned`.|
|status|string|false|read-only|The gateway account's status.|
|sticky|boolean|false|none|Customer's payment instrument will "stick" to the gateway account for future transactions when enabled.|
|threeDSecure|boolean|false|none|True, if Gateway Account allows 3DSecure.|
|timeout|integer \| null|false|none|Gateway Account request timeout in seconds.|
|token|string|false|read-only|Gateway Account token.|
|updatedTime|object|false|none|Gateway Account updated time.|
|credentials|object|true|none|none|

BraintreePayments Gateway config.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|_links|[[SelfLink](#schemaselflink) \| [OnBoardingUrlLink](#schemaonboardingurllink) \| [DynamicIpnLink](#schemadynamicipnlink) \| [StaticIpnLink](#schemastaticipnlink)]|false|read-only|The links related to resource.|
|acceptedCurrencies|[string]|true|none|Accepted currencies (array of the currency three letter codes).|
|acquirerName|object|false|none|none|
|additionalFilters|string|false|none|The additional filters are used to determine whether the gateway account can be selected for the transaction to be processed.<br>For example, the filter may put a maximum amount value. If the transaction is above that amount, this gateway account wouldn't be used.<br>This follows our standard filter format.<br>|
|approvalWindowTtl|integer|false|none|The time window (in seconds) allotted for approving an offsite transaction before it is automatically `abandoned`.|
|cityField|string|false|none|The gateway account's city field (also known as line 2 descriptor).|
|createdTime|object|false|none|Gateway Account created time.|
|dccForceCurrency|string|false|none|Force dynamic currency conversion to the specified currency on each sale.<br>Leave it empty to disable force DCC.<br>|
|dccMarkup|integer|false|none|Dynamic currency conversion markup in basis points.|
|descriptor|string|false|none|The gateway account's descriptor.|
|digitalWallets|[DigitalWallets](#schemadigitalwallets)|false|none|Configure which digital wallets are enabled.|
|dynamicDescriptor|boolean|false|none|True, if Gateway Account allows dynamic descriptor.|
|excludedDccQuoteCurrencies|[string]|false|none|Excluded Dynamic Currency Conversion Quote Currencies.|
|gatewayName|[GatewayName](#schemagatewayname)|true|none|The payment gateway name.|
|id|object|false|read-only|The gateway identifier string.|
|isDown|boolean|false|read-only|True if gateway is currently in downtime period.|
|merchantCategoryCode|string|false|none|The gateway account's merchant category code.|
|method|[PaymentMethod](#schemapaymentmethod)|true|none|The payment method.|
|monthlyLimit|number(double)|false|none|Monthly Limit.|
|organizationId|object|false|read-only|**Deprecated.** Organization ID.|
|paymentCardSchemes|[[PaymentCardBrand](#schemapaymentcardbrand)]|false|none|Accepted payment card brands.|
|reconciliationWindowEnabled|boolean|false|none|If a transaction is not reconciled within the `reconciliationWindowTtl` time, then the transaction is marked as `abandoned`.|
|reconciliationWindowTtl|integer|false|none|The time window (in seconds) allotted for a reconciliation to occur. If it is not reconciled in that time, then the transaction is marked as `abandoned`.|
|status|string|false|read-only|The gateway account's status.|
|sticky|boolean|false|none|Customer's payment instrument will "stick" to the gateway account for future transactions when enabled.|
|threeDSecure|boolean|false|none|True, if Gateway Account allows 3DSecure.|
|timeout|integer \| null|false|none|Gateway Account request timeout in seconds.|
|token|string|false|read-only|Gateway Account token.|
|updatedTime|object|false|none|Gateway Account updated time.|
|credentials|object|true|none|none|

  "colorDepth": 24,
  "isJavaEnabled": true,
  "language": "en-US",
  "screenHeight": 1080,
  "screenWidth": 1920,
  "timeZoneOffset": 300
}
```

Browser data used for 3DS and risk scoring.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|colorDepth|integer|true|none|The browser's color depth in bits per pixel obtained using the `screen.colorDepth` property.|
|isJavaEnabled|boolean|true|none|Whether Java is enabled in a browser or not. Value is returned from the `navigator.javaEnabled` property.|
|language|string|true|none|The browser's language settings returned from the `navigator.language` property.|
|screenHeight|integer|true|none|The browser's screen height returned from the `screen.height` property.|
|screenWidth|integer|true|none|The browser's screen width returned from the `screen.width` property.|
|timeZoneOffset|integer|true|none|The browser's time zone offset in minutes from UTC.<br>A positive offset indicates the local time is behind UTC, and negative is ahead.<br>Can find it with `(new Date()).getTimezoneOffset()` property.<br>|

CashToCode config.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|_links|[[SelfLink](#schemaselflink) \| [OnBoardingUrlLink](#schemaonboardingurllink) \| [DynamicIpnLink](#schemadynamicipnlink) \| [StaticIpnLink](#schemastaticipnlink)]|false|read-only|The links related to resource.|
|acceptedCurrencies|[string]|true|none|Accepted currencies (array of the currency three letter codes).|
|acquirerName|object|false|none|none|
|additionalFilters|string|false|none|The additional filters are used to determine whether the gateway account can be selected for the transaction to be processed.<br>For example, the filter may put a maximum amount value. If the transaction is above that amount, this gateway account wouldn't be used.<br>This follows our standard filter format.<br>|
|approvalWindowTtl|integer|false|none|The time window (in seconds) allotted for approving an offsite transaction before it is automatically `abandoned`.|
|cityField|string|false|none|The gateway account's city field (also known as line 2 descriptor).|
|createdTime|object|false|none|Gateway Account created time.|
|dccForceCurrency|string|false|none|Force dynamic currency conversion to the specified currency on each sale.<br>Leave it empty to disable force DCC.<br>|
|dccMarkup|integer|false|none|Dynamic currency conversion markup in basis points.|
|descriptor|string|false|none|The gateway account's descriptor.|
|digitalWallets|[DigitalWallets](#schemadigitalwallets)|false|none|Configure which digital wallets are enabled.|
|dynamicDescriptor|boolean|false|none|True, if Gateway Account allows dynamic descriptor.|
|excludedDccQuoteCurrencies|[string]|false|none|Excluded Dynamic Currency Conversion Quote Currencies.|
|gatewayName|[GatewayName](#schemagatewayname)|true|none|The payment gateway name.|
|id|object|false|read-only|The gateway identifier string.|
|isDown|boolean|false|read-only|True if gateway is currently in downtime period.|
|merchantCategoryCode|string|false|none|The gateway account's merchant category code.|
|method|[PaymentMethod](#schemapaymentmethod)|true|none|The payment method.|
|monthlyLimit|number(double)|false|none|Monthly Limit.|
|organizationId|object|false|read-only|**Deprecated.** Organization ID.|
|paymentCardSchemes|[[PaymentCardBrand](#schemapaymentcardbrand)]|false|none|Accepted payment card brands.|
|reconciliationWindowEnabled|boolean|false|none|If a transaction is not reconciled within the `reconciliationWindowTtl` time, then the transaction is marked as `abandoned`.|
|reconciliationWindowTtl|integer|false|none|The time window (in seconds) allotted for a reconciliation to occur. If it is not reconciled in that time, then the transaction is marked as `abandoned`.|
|status|string|false|read-only|The gateway account's status.|
|sticky|boolean|false|none|Customer's payment instrument will "stick" to the gateway account for future transactions when enabled.|
|threeDSecure|boolean|false|none|True, if Gateway Account allows 3DSecure.|
|timeout|integer \| null|false|none|Gateway Account request timeout in seconds.|
|token|string|false|read-only|Gateway Account token.|
|updatedTime|object|false|none|Gateway Account updated time.|
|credentials|object|true|none|CashToCode credentials object.|
|settings|object|false|none|none|

|acquirerName|object|false|none|none|
|additionalFilters|string|false|none|The additional filters are used to determine whether the gateway account can be selected for the transaction to be processed.<br>For example, the filter may put a maximum amount value. If the transaction is above that amount, this gateway account wouldn't be used.<br>This follows our standard filter format.<br>|
|approvalWindowTtl|integer|false|none|The time window (in seconds) allotted for approving an offsite transaction before it is automatically `abandoned`.|
|cityField|string|false|none|The gateway account's city field (also known as line 2 descriptor).|
|createdTime|object|false|none|Gateway Account created time.|
|dccForceCurrency|string|false|none|Force dynamic currency conversion to the specified currency on each sale.<br>Leave it empty to disable force DCC.<br>|
|dccMarkup|integer|false|none|Dynamic currency conversion markup in basis points.|
|descriptor|string|false|none|The gateway account's descriptor.|
|digitalWallets|[DigitalWallets](#schemadigitalwallets)|false|none|Configure which digital wallets are enabled.|
|dynamicDescriptor|boolean|false|none|True, if Gateway Account allows dynamic descriptor.|
|excludedDccQuoteCurrencies|[string]|false|none|Excluded Dynamic Currency Conversion Quote Currencies.|
|gatewayName|[GatewayName](#schemagatewayname)|true|none|The payment gateway name.|
|id|object|false|read-only|The gateway identifier string.|
|isDown|boolean|false|read-only|True if gateway is currently in downtime period.|
|merchantCategoryCode|string|false|none|The gateway account's merchant category code.|
|method|[PaymentMethod](#schemapaymentmethod)|true|none|The payment method.|
|monthlyLimit|number(double)|false|none|Monthly Limit.|
|organizationId|object|false|read-only|**Deprecated.** Organization ID.|
|paymentCardSchemes|[[PaymentCardBrand](#schemapaymentcardbrand)]|false|none|Accepted payment card brands.|
|reconciliationWindowEnabled|boolean|false|none|If a transaction is not reconciled within the `reconciliationWindowTtl` time, then the transaction is marked as `abandoned`.|
|reconciliationWindowTtl|integer|false|none|The time window (in seconds) allotted for a reconciliation to occur. If it is not reconciled in that time, then the transaction is marked as `abandoned`.|
|status|string|false|read-only|The gateway account's status.|
|sticky|boolean|false|none|Customer's payment instrument will "stick" to the gateway account for future transactions when enabled.|
|threeDSecure|boolean|false|none|True, if Gateway Account allows 3DSecure.|
|timeout|integer \| null|false|none|Gateway Account request timeout in seconds.|
|token|string|false|read-only|Gateway Account token.|
|updatedTime|object|false|none|Gateway Account updated time.|
|credentials|object|true|none|Circle credentials object.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|_links|[[SelfLink](#schemaselflink) \| [OnBoardingUrlLink](#schemaonboardingurllink) \| [DynamicIpnLink](#schemadynamicipnlink) \| [StaticIpnLink](#schemastaticipnlink)]|false|read-only|The links related to resource.|
|acceptedCurrencies|[string]|true|none|Accepted currencies (array of the currency three letter codes).|
|acquirerName|object|false|none|none|
|additionalFilters|string|false|none|The additional filters are used to determine whether the gateway account can be selected for the transaction to be processed.<br>For example, the filter may put a maximum amount value. If the transaction is above that amount, this gateway account wouldn't be used.<br>This follows our standard filter format.<br>|
|approvalWindowTtl|integer|false|none|The time window (in seconds) allotted for approving an offsite transaction before it is automatically `abandoned`.|
|cityField|string|false|none|The gateway account's city field (also known as line 2 descriptor).|
|createdTime|object|false|none|Gateway Account created time.|
|dccForceCurrency|string|false|none|Force dynamic currency conversion to the specified currency on each sale.<br>Leave it empty to disable force DCC.<br>|
|dccMarkup|integer|false|none|Dynamic currency conversion markup in basis points.|
|descriptor|string|false|none|The gateway account's descriptor.|
|digitalWallets|[DigitalWallets](#schemadigitalwallets)|false|none|Configure which digital wallets are enabled.|
|dynamicDescriptor|boolean|false|none|True, if Gateway Account allows dynamic descriptor.|
|excludedDccQuoteCurrencies|[string]|false|none|Excluded Dynamic Currency Conversion Quote Currencies.|
|gatewayName|[GatewayName](#schemagatewayname)|true|none|The payment gateway name.|
|id|object|false|read-only|The gateway identifier string.|
|isDown|boolean|false|read-only|True if gateway is currently in downtime period.|
|merchantCategoryCode|string|false|none|The gateway account's merchant category code.|
|method|[PaymentMethod](#schemapaymentmethod)|true|none|The payment method.|
|monthlyLimit|number(double)|false|none|Monthly Limit.|
|organizationId|object|false|read-only|**Deprecated.** Organization ID.|
|paymentCardSchemes|[[PaymentCardBrand](#schemapaymentcardbrand)]|false|none|Accepted payment card brands.|
|reconciliationWindowEnabled|boolean|false|none|If a transaction is not reconciled within the `reconciliationWindowTtl` time, then the transaction is marked as `abandoned`.|
|reconciliationWindowTtl|integer|false|none|The time window (in seconds) allotted for a reconciliation to occur. If it is not reconciled in that time, then the transaction is marked as `abandoned`.|
|status|string|false|read-only|The gateway account's status.|
|sticky|boolean|false|none|Customer's payment instrument will "stick" to the gateway account for future transactions when enabled.|
|threeDSecure|boolean|false|none|True, if Gateway Account allows 3DSecure.|
|timeout|integer \| null|false|none|Gateway Account request timeout in seconds.|
|token|string|false|read-only|Gateway Account token.|
|updatedTime|object|false|none|Gateway Account updated time.|
|credentials|object|true|none|CoinPayments credentials object.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|createdTime|object|false|none|Plan created time.|
|currency|object|true|none|none|

|updatedTime|object|false|none|Plan updated time.|

<h2 id="tocS_CommonProduct">CommonProduct</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemacommonproduct"></a>
<a id="schema_CommonProduct"></a>
<a id="tocScommonproduct"></a>
<a id="tocscommonproduct"></a>

```json
{
  "createdTime": {},
  "customFields": {
    "foo": "bar"
  },
  "description": "string",
  "id": "membership",
  "name": "Premium membership",
  "options": [
    "string"
  ],
  "requiresShipping": false,
  "unitLabel": "seat",
  "updatedTime": {}
}
```

Products include digital goods, services, and physical goods.
Products appear on invoice line items. If you set a tax category identifier,
taxes will be calculated upon invoice generation. If it is shippable,
shipping will be calculated upon invoice generation. Pricing and
variations are set within Plans.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|createdTime|object|false|none|The product created time.|
|customFields|[ResourceCustomFields](#schemaresourcecustomfields)|false|none|Custom Fields list as a map `{"custom field name": "custom field value", ...}`. The format must follow the saved format (see Custom Fields section for the formats).<br>|
|description|string|false|none|The product description.|
|id|object|false|read-only|The product ID.|
|name|string|true|none|The product name.|
|options|[string]|false|none|The product options such as color, size, etc. The product options definition does<br>not include option values. Those are defined within the plans.<br>|
|requiresShipping|boolean|false|none|If the product requires shipping, shipping calculations will be applied.|
|unitLabel|string|false|none|The unit label, such as per `seat` or per `unit`.|
|updatedTime|object|false|none|The product updated time.|

|websiteId|object|false|none|The website identifier string.|
|autopay|boolean|false|none|Autopay determines if a payment attempt will be automatic.|
|endTime|object|false|none|Subscription end time.|
|inTrial|boolean|false|read-only|True if the subscription is currently in a trial period.|
|invoiceTimeShift|object \| null|false|none|You can shift issue time and due time of invoices for this subscription.<br>This setting overrides plan settings. To use plan settings, set `null`.<br>To use multiple plans in one subscription they all must have the same billing period,<br>this property allows to subscribe to different plans.<br>|
|isTrialOnly|boolean|false|none|Whether a subscription ends after a trial period. Recurring settings are ignored if it's `true`.|
|lineItemSubtotal|object|false|read-only|Subtotal of line items in this subscription (signed value). If credits exceed debits, it will be a negative number.|
|lineItems|object|false|read-only|Subscription line items which queue until the next renewal (or interim) invoice is issued for the subscription.|
|rebillNumber|integer|false|read-only|The current period number.|
|recurringInterval|object \| null|false|none|The recurring interval to override plan settings. To use plan settings, set `null`.<br>To use multiple plans in one subscription they all must have the same recurring period length,<br>this property allows to subscribe to different plans.<br>|
|renewalTime|string(date-time)|false|none|Subscription renewal time.|
|startTime|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|Subscription start time.  When the value is sent as null, it will use the current time. This value can't be in past more than one service period.|
|status|string|false|read-only|The status of the subscription service. A subscription starts<br>in the `pending` status, and will become `active` when the<br>service period begins.<br>|
|trial|object|false|none|To use plan defaults do not send the `trial` key, or send a `null`. value with it.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|amount|number(double)|true|none|The transaction amount.|
|billingAddress|object \| null|false|none|Billing address. If not supplied, we use the billing address associated with the payment instrument, and then customer.|
|currency|object|true|none|none|
|customFields|[ResourceCustomFields](#schemaresourcecustomfields)|false|none|Custom Fields list as a map `{"custom field name": "custom field value", ...}`. The format must follow the saved format (see Custom Fields section for the formats).<br>|
|customerId|object|true|none|The customer identifier string.|
|description|string \| null|false|none|The payment description.|
|gatewayAccountId|object \| null|false|none|Rebilly will select the appropriate payment gateway account for the transaction based on the properties of the transaction and the `gateway-account-requested` event rules configurations. If you wish to prevent Rebilly from making the gateway account selection, you may supply a gateway account id here, and it will be used instead. Only use this field if you intend to override the settings.|
|invoiceIds|[[ResourceId](#schemaresourceid)]|false|none|The array of invoice identifiers.|
|isMerchantInitiated|boolean|false|none|True if the transaction was initiated by the merchant.|
|isProcessedOutside|boolean|false|none|True if transaction was processed outside Rebilly.|
|notificationUrl|string(uri) \| null|false|none|The URL where a server-to-server notification request type `POST` with a transaction payload will be sent when the transaction's result is finalized. Do not trust the notification; follow with a `GET` request to confirm the result of the transaction. Please respond with a `2xx` HTTP status code, or we will reattempt the request again. You may use `{id}` or `{result}` as placeholders in the URL and we will replace them with the transaction's id and result accordingly.<br>|
|paymentInstruction|object|false|none|Payment instruction. If not supplied, customer's default payment instrument will be used.|
|paymentInstrument|object|false|none|**Deprecated.**|
|processedTime|string(date-time)|false|none|The time the transaction was processed. Can be specified only if transaction was processed outside Rebilly.|
|redirectUrl|string(uri) \| null|false|none|The URL to redirect the end-user when an offsite transaction is completed. Defaults to the website's configured URL. You may use `{id}` or `{result}` as placeholders in the URL and we will replace them with the transaction's id and result accordingly.|
|requestId|string \| null|false|none|The request id is **recommended**. It prevents duplicate transaction requests within a short period of time. If a duplicate request is sent with the same `requestId` it will be ignored to prevent double-billing anyone.  It must be unique within a 24-hour period.  We recommend generating a UUID v4 as its value.|
|riskMetadata|[RiskMetadata](#schemariskmetadata)|false|none|Risk metadata used for 3DS and risk scoring.|
|websiteId|object|true|none|The website identifier string.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|_links|[[SelfLink](#schemaselflink) \| [OnBoardingUrlLink](#schemaonboardingurllink) \| [DynamicIpnLink](#schemadynamicipnlink) \| [StaticIpnLink](#schemastaticipnlink)]|false|read-only|The links related to resource.|
|acceptedCurrencies|[string]|true|none|Accepted currencies (array of the currency three letter codes).|
|acquirerName|object|false|none|none|
|additionalFilters|string|false|none|The additional filters are used to determine whether the gateway account can be selected for the transaction to be processed.<br>For example, the filter may put a maximum amount value. If the transaction is above that amount, this gateway account wouldn't be used.<br>This follows our standard filter format.<br>|
|approvalWindowTtl|integer|false|none|The time window (in seconds) allotted for approving an offsite transaction before it is automatically `abandoned`.|
|cityField|string|false|none|The gateway account's city field (also known as line 2 descriptor).|
|createdTime|object|false|none|Gateway Account created time.|
|dccForceCurrency|string|false|none|Force dynamic currency conversion to the specified currency on each sale.<br>Leave it empty to disable force DCC.<br>|
|dccMarkup|integer|false|none|Dynamic currency conversion markup in basis points.|
|descriptor|string|false|none|The gateway account's descriptor.|
|digitalWallets|[DigitalWallets](#schemadigitalwallets)|false|none|Configure which digital wallets are enabled.|
|dynamicDescriptor|boolean|false|none|True, if Gateway Account allows dynamic descriptor.|
|excludedDccQuoteCurrencies|[string]|false|none|Excluded Dynamic Currency Conversion Quote Currencies.|
|gatewayName|[GatewayName](#schemagatewayname)|true|none|The payment gateway name.|
|id|object|false|read-only|The gateway identifier string.|
|isDown|boolean|false|read-only|True if gateway is currently in downtime period.|
|merchantCategoryCode|string|false|none|The gateway account's merchant category code.|
|method|[PaymentMethod](#schemapaymentmethod)|true|none|The payment method.|
|monthlyLimit|number(double)|false|none|Monthly Limit.|
|organizationId|object|false|read-only|**Deprecated.** Organization ID.|
|paymentCardSchemes|[[PaymentCardBrand](#schemapaymentcardbrand)]|false|none|Accepted payment card brands.|
|reconciliationWindowEnabled|boolean|false|none|If a transaction is not reconciled within the `reconciliationWindowTtl` time, then the transaction is marked as `abandoned`.|
|reconciliationWindowTtl|integer|false|none|The time window (in seconds) allotted for a reconciliation to occur. If it is not reconciled in that time, then the transaction is marked as `abandoned`.|
|status|string|false|read-only|The gateway account's status.|
|sticky|boolean|false|none|Customer's payment instrument will "stick" to the gateway account for future transactions when enabled.|
|threeDSecure|boolean|false|none|True, if Gateway Account allows 3DSecure.|
|timeout|integer \| null|false|none|Gateway Account request timeout in seconds.|
|token|string|false|read-only|Gateway Account token.|
|updatedTime|object|false|none|Gateway Account updated time.|
|credentials|object|true|none|Conekta credentials object.|

|approvalWindowTtl|integer|false|none|The time window (in seconds) allotted for approving an offsite transaction before it is automatically `abandoned`.|
|cityField|string|false|none|The gateway account's city field (also known as line 2 descriptor).|
|createdTime|object|false|none|Gateway Account created time.|

|descriptor|string|false|none|The gateway account's descriptor.|
|digitalWallets|[DigitalWallets](#schemadigitalwallets)|false|none|Configure which digital wallets are enabled.|

|gatewayName|[GatewayName](#schemagatewayname)|true|none|The payment gateway name.|

|reconciliationWindowEnabled|boolean|false|none|If a transaction is not reconciled within the `reconciliationWindowTtl` time, then the transaction is marked as `abandoned`.|
|reconciliationWindowTtl|integer|false|none|The time window (in seconds) allotted for a reconciliation to occur. If it is not reconciled in that time, then the transaction is marked as `abandoned`.|
|status|string|false|read-only|The gateway account's status.|
|sticky|boolean|false|none|Customer's payment instrument will "stick" to the gateway account for future transactions when enabled.|
|threeDSecure|boolean|false|none|True, if Gateway Account allows 3DSecure.|
|timeout|integer \| null|false|none|Gateway Account request timeout in seconds.|
|token|string|false|read-only|Gateway Account token.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|_links|[[SelfLink](#schemaselflink) \| [OnBoardingUrlLink](#schemaonboardingurllink) \| [DynamicIpnLink](#schemadynamicipnlink) \| [StaticIpnLink](#schemastaticipnlink)]|false|read-only|The links related to resource.|
|acceptedCurrencies|[string]|true|none|Accepted currencies (array of the currency three letter codes).|
|acquirerName|object|false|none|none|
|additionalFilters|string|false|none|The additional filters are used to determine whether the gateway account can be selected for the transaction to be processed.<br>For example, the filter may put a maximum amount value. If the transaction is above that amount, this gateway account wouldn't be used.<br>This follows our standard filter format.<br>|
|approvalWindowTtl|integer|false|none|The time window (in seconds) allotted for approving an offsite transaction before it is automatically `abandoned`.|
|cityField|string|false|none|The gateway account's city field (also known as line 2 descriptor).|
|createdTime|object|false|none|Gateway Account created time.|
|dccForceCurrency|string|false|none|Force dynamic currency conversion to the specified currency on each sale.<br>Leave it empty to disable force DCC.<br>|
|dccMarkup|integer|false|none|Dynamic currency conversion markup in basis points.|
|descriptor|string|false|none|The gateway account's descriptor.|
|digitalWallets|[DigitalWallets](#schemadigitalwallets)|false|none|Configure which digital wallets are enabled.|
|dynamicDescriptor|boolean|false|none|True, if Gateway Account allows dynamic descriptor.|
|excludedDccQuoteCurrencies|[string]|false|none|Excluded Dynamic Currency Conversion Quote Currencies.|
|gatewayName|[GatewayName](#schemagatewayname)|true|none|The payment gateway name.|
|id|object|false|read-only|The gateway identifier string.|
|isDown|boolean|false|read-only|True if gateway is currently in downtime period.|
|merchantCategoryCode|string|false|none|The gateway account's merchant category code.|
|method|[PaymentMethod](#schemapaymentmethod)|true|none|The payment method.|
|monthlyLimit|number(double)|false|none|Monthly Limit.|
|organizationId|object|false|read-only|**Deprecated.** Organization ID.|
|paymentCardSchemes|[[PaymentCardBrand](#schemapaymentcardbrand)]|false|none|Accepted payment card brands.|
|reconciliationWindowEnabled|boolean|false|none|If a transaction is not reconciled within the `reconciliationWindowTtl` time, then the transaction is marked as `abandoned`.|
|reconciliationWindowTtl|integer|false|none|The time window (in seconds) allotted for a reconciliation to occur. If it is not reconciled in that time, then the transaction is marked as `abandoned`.|
|status|string|false|read-only|The gateway account's status.|
|sticky|boolean|false|none|Customer's payment instrument will "stick" to the gateway account for future transactions when enabled.|
|threeDSecure|boolean|false|none|True, if Gateway Account allows 3DSecure.|
|timeout|integer \| null|false|none|Gateway Account request timeout in seconds.|
|token|string|false|read-only|Gateway Account token.|
|updatedTime|object|false|none|Gateway Account updated time.|
|credentials|object|true|none|none|

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

|_links|[[SelfLink](#schemaselflink) \| [OnBoardingUrlLink](#schemaonboardingurllink) \| [DynamicIpnLink](#schemadynamicipnlink) \| [StaticIpnLink](#schemastaticipnlink)]|false|read-only|The links related to resource.|
|acceptedCurrencies|[string]|true|none|Accepted currencies (array of the currency three letter codes).|
|acquirerName|object|false|none|none|
|additionalFilters|string|false|none|The additional filters are used to determine whether the gateway account can be selected for the transaction to be processed.<br>For example, the filter may put a maximum amount value. If the transaction is above that amount, this gateway account wouldn't be used.<br>This follows our standard filter format.<br>|
|approvalWindowTtl|integer|false|none|The time window (in seconds) allotted for approving an offsite transaction before it is automatically `abandoned`.|
|cityField|string|false|none|The gateway account's city field (also known as line 2 descriptor).|
|createdTime|object|false|none|Gateway Account created time.|
|dccForceCurrency|string|false|none|Force dynamic currency conversion to the specified currency on each sale.<br>Leave it empty to disable force DCC.<br>|
|dccMarkup|integer|false|none|Dynamic currency conversion markup in basis points.|
|descriptor|string|false|none|The gateway account's descriptor.|
|digitalWallets|[DigitalWallets](#schemadigitalwallets)|false|none|Configure which digital wallets are enabled.|
|dynamicDescriptor|boolean|false|none|True, if Gateway Account allows dynamic descriptor.|
|excludedDccQuoteCurrencies|[string]|false|none|Excluded Dynamic Currency Conversion Quote Currencies.|
|gatewayName|[GatewayName](#schemagatewayname)|true|none|The payment gateway name.|
|id|object|false|read-only|The gateway identifier string.|
|isDown|boolean|false|read-only|True if gateway is currently in downtime period.|
|merchantCategoryCode|string|false|none|The gateway account's merchant category code.|
|method|[PaymentMethod](#schemapaymentmethod)|true|none|The payment method.|
|monthlyLimit|number(double)|false|none|Monthly Limit.|

|paymentCardSchemes|[[PaymentCardBrand](#schemapaymentcardbrand)]|false|none|Accepted payment card brands.|
|reconciliationWindowEnabled|boolean|false|none|If a transaction is not reconciled within the `reconciliationWindowTtl` time, then the transaction is marked as `abandoned`.|
|reconciliationWindowTtl|integer|false|none|The time window (in seconds) allotted for a reconciliation to occur. If it is not reconciled in that time, then the transaction is marked as `abandoned`.|
|status|string|false|read-only|The gateway account's status.|
|sticky|boolean|false|none|Customer's payment instrument will "stick" to the gateway account for future transactions when enabled.|
|threeDSecure|boolean|false|none|True, if Gateway Account allows 3DSecure.|
|timeout|integer \| null|false|none|Gateway Account request timeout in seconds.|
|token|string|false|read-only|Gateway Account token.|

|sticky|boolean|false|none|Customer's payment instrument will "stick" to the gateway account for future transactions when enabled.|

<h2 id="tocS_DueTimeShiftInstruction">DueTimeShiftInstruction</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaduetimeshiftinstruction"></a>
<a id="schema_DueTimeShiftInstruction"></a>
<a id="tocSduetimeshiftinstruction"></a>
<a id="tocsduetimeshiftinstruction"></a>

```json
{
  "duration": 1,
  "unit": "hour"
}
```

The calculation instruction of due time.
This is used in conjunction with the **billing anchor** to calculate due time of invoice.
The chronology of due time shift is always **after**.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|duration|integer|true|none|The number of the units.|
|unit|[TimeUnit](#schematimeunit) \| [TimePluralUnit](#schematimepluralunit)|true|none|none|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|_links|[[SelfLink](#schemaselflink) \| [OnBoardingUrlLink](#schemaonboardingurllink) \| [DynamicIpnLink](#schemadynamicipnlink) \| [StaticIpnLink](#schemastaticipnlink)]|false|read-only|The links related to resource.|
|acceptedCurrencies|[string]|true|none|Accepted currencies (array of the currency three letter codes).|
|acquirerName|object|false|none|none|
|additionalFilters|string|false|none|The additional filters are used to determine whether the gateway account can be selected for the transaction to be processed.<br>For example, the filter may put a maximum amount value. If the transaction is above that amount, this gateway account wouldn't be used.<br>This follows our standard filter format.<br>|
|approvalWindowTtl|integer|false|none|The time window (in seconds) allotted for approving an offsite transaction before it is automatically `abandoned`.|
|cityField|string|false|none|The gateway account's city field (also known as line 2 descriptor).|
|createdTime|object|false|none|Gateway Account created time.|
|dccForceCurrency|string|false|none|Force dynamic currency conversion to the specified currency on each sale.<br>Leave it empty to disable force DCC.<br>|
|dccMarkup|integer|false|none|Dynamic currency conversion markup in basis points.|
|descriptor|string|false|none|The gateway account's descriptor.|
|digitalWallets|[DigitalWallets](#schemadigitalwallets)|false|none|Configure which digital wallets are enabled.|
|dynamicDescriptor|boolean|false|none|True, if Gateway Account allows dynamic descriptor.|
|excludedDccQuoteCurrencies|[string]|false|none|Excluded Dynamic Currency Conversion Quote Currencies.|
|gatewayName|[GatewayName](#schemagatewayname)|true|none|The payment gateway name.|
|id|object|false|read-only|The gateway identifier string.|
|isDown|boolean|false|read-only|True if gateway is currently in downtime period.|
|merchantCategoryCode|string|false|none|The gateway account's merchant category code.|
|method|[PaymentMethod](#schemapaymentmethod)|true|none|The payment method.|
|monthlyLimit|number(double)|false|none|Monthly Limit.|
|organizationId|object|false|read-only|**Deprecated.** Organization ID.|
|paymentCardSchemes|[[PaymentCardBrand](#schemapaymentcardbrand)]|false|none|Accepted payment card brands.|
|reconciliationWindowEnabled|boolean|false|none|If a transaction is not reconciled within the `reconciliationWindowTtl` time, then the transaction is marked as `abandoned`.|
|reconciliationWindowTtl|integer|false|none|The time window (in seconds) allotted for a reconciliation to occur. If it is not reconciled in that time, then the transaction is marked as `abandoned`.|
|status|string|false|read-only|The gateway account's status.|
|sticky|boolean|false|none|Customer's payment instrument will "stick" to the gateway account for future transactions when enabled.|
|threeDSecure|boolean|false|none|True, if Gateway Account allows 3DSecure.|
|timeout|integer \| null|false|none|Gateway Account request timeout in seconds.|
|token|string|false|read-only|Gateway Account token.|
|updatedTime|object|false|none|Gateway Account updated time.|
|credentials|object|true|none|EPG credentials object.|

<a id="tocsfile"></a>

```json
{
  "_links": [
    {
      "href": "string",
      "rel": "self"
    },
    {
      "href": "string",
      "rel": "self"
    },
    {
      "href": "string",
      "rel": "self"
    }
  ],
  "createdTime": {},
  "description": "string",
  "extension": "string",
  "height": 0,
  "id": {},
  "isPublic": true,
  "mime": "image/png",
  "name": "string",
  "sha1": "string",
  "size": 0,
  "tags": [
    "string"
  ],
  "updatedTime": {},
  "width": 0
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|_links|[[SelfLink](#schemaselflink) \| [FileDownloadLink](#schemafiledownloadlink) \| [SignedLinkLink](#schemasignedlinklink) \| [PermalinkLink](#schemapermalinklink)]|false|read-only|The links related to resource.|
|createdTime|object|false|none|The upload date/time.|
|description|string|false|none|The File description.|
|extension|string|false|none|The File extension.|
|height|integer|false|read-only|Image height, applicable to images only.|
|id|object|false|read-only|none|
|isPublic|boolean|false|none|Is the file available publicly (without authentication). If true, the permalink in the _links section contains the public URL.|
|mime|string|false|read-only|The mime type.|
|name|string|false|none|Original File name.|
|sha1|string|false|read-only|Hash sum of the file.|
|size|integer|false|read-only|The File size in bytes.|
|tags|[string]|false|none|The tags list.|
|updatedTime|object|false|none|The latest update date/time.|
|width|integer|false|read-only|Image width, applicable to images only.|

|mime|image/jpeg|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|_links|[[SelfLink](#schemaselflink) \| [OnBoardingUrlLink](#schemaonboardingurllink) \| [DynamicIpnLink](#schemadynamicipnlink) \| [StaticIpnLink](#schemastaticipnlink)]|false|read-only|The links related to resource.|
|acceptedCurrencies|[string]|true|none|Accepted currencies (array of the currency three letter codes).|
|acquirerName|object|false|none|none|
|additionalFilters|string|false|none|The additional filters are used to determine whether the gateway account can be selected for the transaction to be processed.<br>For example, the filter may put a maximum amount value. If the transaction is above that amount, this gateway account wouldn't be used.<br>This follows our standard filter format.<br>|
|approvalWindowTtl|integer|false|none|The time window (in seconds) allotted for approving an offsite transaction before it is automatically `abandoned`.|
|cityField|string|false|none|The gateway account's city field (also known as line 2 descriptor).|
|createdTime|object|false|none|Gateway Account created time.|
|dccForceCurrency|string|false|none|Force dynamic currency conversion to the specified currency on each sale.<br>Leave it empty to disable force DCC.<br>|
|dccMarkup|integer|false|none|Dynamic currency conversion markup in basis points.|
|descriptor|string|false|none|The gateway account's descriptor.|
|digitalWallets|[DigitalWallets](#schemadigitalwallets)|false|none|Configure which digital wallets are enabled.|
|dynamicDescriptor|boolean|false|none|True, if Gateway Account allows dynamic descriptor.|
|excludedDccQuoteCurrencies|[string]|false|none|Excluded Dynamic Currency Conversion Quote Currencies.|
|gatewayName|[GatewayName](#schemagatewayname)|true|none|The payment gateway name.|
|id|object|false|read-only|The gateway identifier string.|
|isDown|boolean|false|read-only|True if gateway is currently in downtime period.|
|merchantCategoryCode|string|false|none|The gateway account's merchant category code.|
|method|[PaymentMethod](#schemapaymentmethod)|true|none|The payment method.|
|monthlyLimit|number(double)|false|none|Monthly Limit.|
|organizationId|object|false|read-only|**Deprecated.** Organization ID.|
|paymentCardSchemes|[[PaymentCardBrand](#schemapaymentcardbrand)]|false|none|Accepted payment card brands.|
|reconciliationWindowEnabled|boolean|false|none|If a transaction is not reconciled within the `reconciliationWindowTtl` time, then the transaction is marked as `abandoned`.|
|reconciliationWindowTtl|integer|false|none|The time window (in seconds) allotted for a reconciliation to occur. If it is not reconciled in that time, then the transaction is marked as `abandoned`.|
|status|string|false|read-only|The gateway account's status.|
|sticky|boolean|false|none|Customer's payment instrument will "stick" to the gateway account for future transactions when enabled.|
|threeDSecure|boolean|false|none|True, if Gateway Account allows 3DSecure.|
|timeout|integer \| null|false|none|Gateway Account request timeout in seconds.|
|token|string|false|read-only|Gateway Account token.|
|updatedTime|object|false|none|Gateway Account updated time.|
|credentials|object|true|none|FinTecSystems credentials object.|
|settings|object|true|none|FinTecSystems settings object.|

<a id="tocsflexibleplan"></a>

```json
{
  "createdTime": {},
  "currency": {},
  "currencySign": "string",
  "customFields": {
    "foo": "bar"
  },
  "id": {},
  "isTrialOnly": true,
  "name": "string",
  "pricing": {
    "formula": "fixed-fee"
  },
  "productId": {},
  "productOptions": {
    "color": "red",
    "size": "xxl"
  },
  "recurringInterval": {
    "length": 0,
    "unit": "day",
    "billingTiming": "prepaid",
    "limit": 0
  },
  "revision": 0,
  "setup": {
    "price": 0
  },
  "trial": {
    "period": {
      "length": 0,
      "unit": "day"
    },
    "price": 0
  },
  "updatedTime": {}
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|createdTime|object|false|none|Plan created time.|
|currency|object|true|none|none|
|currencySign|string|false|read-only|Currency sign.|
|customFields|[ResourceCustomFields](#schemaresourcecustomfields)|false|none|Custom Fields list as a map `{"custom field name": "custom field value", ...}`. The format must follow the saved format (see Custom Fields section for the formats).<br>|
|id|object|true|read-only|The plan ID.|
|isTrialOnly|boolean|false|read-only|Whether a plan has a trial without recurring instructions.|
|name|string|true|none|The plan name, displayed on invoices and receipts.|
|pricing|[PlanPriceFormula](#schemaplanpriceformula)|true|none|none|
|productId|object|true|none|The related product ID.|
|productOptions|object|false|none|Name-value pairs to specify the product options.|
|recurringInterval|object|false|none|The service interval. For a one-time item, use `null`.|
|revision|integer|false|read-only|Increments when the plan is modified. <br>Compare to materialized subscription items revision.<br>|
|setup|object|false|none|The setup. Set `null` if no setup.|
|trial|object|false|none|The trial. Set `null` if no trial.|
|updatedTime|object|false|none|Plan updated time.|
|id|object|true|none|The Plan identifier.|

Forte Gateway config.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|_links|[[SelfLink](#schemaselflink) \| [OnBoardingUrlLink](#schemaonboardingurllink) \| [DynamicIpnLink](#schemadynamicipnlink) \| [StaticIpnLink](#schemastaticipnlink)]|false|read-only|The links related to resource.|
|acceptedCurrencies|[string]|true|none|Accepted currencies (array of the currency three letter codes).|
|acquirerName|object|false|none|none|
|additionalFilters|string|false|none|The additional filters are used to determine whether the gateway account can be selected for the transaction to be processed.<br>For example, the filter may put a maximum amount value. If the transaction is above that amount, this gateway account wouldn't be used.<br>This follows our standard filter format.<br>|
|approvalWindowTtl|integer|false|none|The time window (in seconds) allotted for approving an offsite transaction before it is automatically `abandoned`.|
|cityField|string|false|none|The gateway account's city field (also known as line 2 descriptor).|
|createdTime|object|false|none|Gateway Account created time.|
|dccForceCurrency|string|false|none|Force dynamic currency conversion to the specified currency on each sale.<br>Leave it empty to disable force DCC.<br>|
|dccMarkup|integer|false|none|Dynamic currency conversion markup in basis points.|
|descriptor|string|false|none|The gateway account's descriptor.|
|digitalWallets|[DigitalWallets](#schemadigitalwallets)|false|none|Configure which digital wallets are enabled.|
|dynamicDescriptor|boolean|false|none|True, if Gateway Account allows dynamic descriptor.|
|excludedDccQuoteCurrencies|[string]|false|none|Excluded Dynamic Currency Conversion Quote Currencies.|
|gatewayName|[GatewayName](#schemagatewayname)|true|none|The payment gateway name.|
|id|object|false|read-only|The gateway identifier string.|
|isDown|boolean|false|read-only|True if gateway is currently in downtime period.|
|merchantCategoryCode|string|false|none|The gateway account's merchant category code.|
|method|[PaymentMethod](#schemapaymentmethod)|true|none|The payment method.|
|monthlyLimit|number(double)|false|none|Monthly Limit.|
|organizationId|object|false|read-only|**Deprecated.** Organization ID.|
|paymentCardSchemes|[[PaymentCardBrand](#schemapaymentcardbrand)]|false|none|Accepted payment card brands.|
|reconciliationWindowEnabled|boolean|false|none|If a transaction is not reconciled within the `reconciliationWindowTtl` time, then the transaction is marked as `abandoned`.|
|reconciliationWindowTtl|integer|false|none|The time window (in seconds) allotted for a reconciliation to occur. If it is not reconciled in that time, then the transaction is marked as `abandoned`.|
|status|string|false|read-only|The gateway account's status.|
|sticky|boolean|false|none|Customer's payment instrument will "stick" to the gateway account for future transactions when enabled.|
|threeDSecure|boolean|false|none|True, if Gateway Account allows 3DSecure.|
|timeout|integer \| null|false|none|Gateway Account request timeout in seconds.|
|token|string|false|read-only|Gateway Account token.|
|updatedTime|object|false|none|Gateway Account updated time.|
|credentials|object|true|none|none|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|_links|[[SelfLink](#schemaselflink) \| [OnBoardingUrlLink](#schemaonboardingurllink) \| [DynamicIpnLink](#schemadynamicipnlink) \| [StaticIpnLink](#schemastaticipnlink)]|false|read-only|The links related to resource.|
|acceptedCurrencies|[string]|true|none|Accepted currencies (array of the currency three letter codes).|
|acquirerName|object|false|none|none|
|additionalFilters|string|false|none|The additional filters are used to determine whether the gateway account can be selected for the transaction to be processed.<br>For example, the filter may put a maximum amount value. If the transaction is above that amount, this gateway account wouldn't be used.<br>This follows our standard filter format.<br>|
|approvalWindowTtl|integer|false|none|The time window (in seconds) allotted for approving an offsite transaction before it is automatically `abandoned`.|
|cityField|string|false|none|The gateway account's city field (also known as line 2 descriptor).|
|createdTime|object|false|none|Gateway Account created time.|
|dccForceCurrency|string|false|none|Force dynamic currency conversion to the specified currency on each sale.<br>Leave it empty to disable force DCC.<br>|
|dccMarkup|integer|false|none|Dynamic currency conversion markup in basis points.|
|descriptor|string|false|none|The gateway account's descriptor.|
|digitalWallets|[DigitalWallets](#schemadigitalwallets)|false|none|Configure which digital wallets are enabled.|
|dynamicDescriptor|boolean|false|none|True, if Gateway Account allows dynamic descriptor.|
|excludedDccQuoteCurrencies|[string]|false|none|Excluded Dynamic Currency Conversion Quote Currencies.|
|gatewayName|[GatewayName](#schemagatewayname)|true|none|The payment gateway name.|
|id|object|false|read-only|The gateway identifier string.|
|isDown|boolean|false|read-only|True if gateway is currently in downtime period.|
|merchantCategoryCode|string|false|none|The gateway account's merchant category code.|
|method|[PaymentMethod](#schemapaymentmethod)|true|none|The payment method.|
|monthlyLimit|number(double)|false|none|Monthly Limit.|
|organizationId|object|false|read-only|**Deprecated.** Organization ID.|
|paymentCardSchemes|[[PaymentCardBrand](#schemapaymentcardbrand)]|false|none|Accepted payment card brands.|
|reconciliationWindowEnabled|boolean|false|none|If a transaction is not reconciled within the `reconciliationWindowTtl` time, then the transaction is marked as `abandoned`.|
|reconciliationWindowTtl|integer|false|none|The time window (in seconds) allotted for a reconciliation to occur. If it is not reconciled in that time, then the transaction is marked as `abandoned`.|
|status|string|false|read-only|The gateway account's status.|
|sticky|boolean|false|none|Customer's payment instrument will "stick" to the gateway account for future transactions when enabled.|
|threeDSecure|boolean|false|none|True, if Gateway Account allows 3DSecure.|
|timeout|integer \| null|false|none|Gateway Account request timeout in seconds.|
|token|string|false|read-only|Gateway Account token.|
|updatedTime|object|false|none|Gateway Account updated time.|

<h2 id="tocS_GatewayAccountLimit">GatewayAccountLimit</h2>

{
  "_links": [
    {
      "href": "string",
      "rel": "self"
    }
  ],
  "cap": 1000,
  "createdTime": {},
  "endTime": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "frequency": "daily",
  "id": {},
  "startTime": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "status": "monitoring",
  "type": "count",

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|_links|[[SelfLink](#schemaselflink)]|false|read-only|The links related to resource.|
|cap|integer|true|none|The limit's value cap is the maximum desired value.<br>If type is money, the currency is the report currency.<br>The cap only applies to approved transactions of type `authorize` or `sale`.<br>|
|createdTime|object|false|none|Gateway account limit created time.|
|endTime|string(date-time)|false|read-only|The limit's current period end time. At this time, the limit will reset.|
|frequency|string|false|read-only|The limit's period will reset according to the frequency.|
|id|object|false|read-only|The gateway account limit identifier.|
|startTime|string(date-time)|false|read-only|The limit's current period start time.|
|status|string|false|read-only|The gateway account limit status.|
|type|string|false|read-only|The limit can be on `money` or `count` of transactions.<br>If `money` is chosen, the currency is the report currency.<br>|
|updatedTime|object|false|none|Gateway account limit updated time.|
|usage|integer|false|read-only|The limit's actual usage during this period.|

|frequency|monthly|
|status|monitoring|
|status|reached|

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

|_links|[[SelfLink](#schemaselflink) \| [OnBoardingUrlLink](#schemaonboardingurllink) \| [DynamicIpnLink](#schemadynamicipnlink) \| [StaticIpnLink](#schemastaticipnlink)]|false|read-only|The links related to resource.|
|acceptedCurrencies|[string]|true|none|Accepted currencies (array of the currency three letter codes).|
|acquirerName|object|false|none|none|
|additionalFilters|string|false|none|The additional filters are used to determine whether the gateway account can be selected for the transaction to be processed.<br>For example, the filter may put a maximum amount value. If the transaction is above that amount, this gateway account wouldn't be used.<br>This follows our standard filter format.<br>|

|reconciliationWindowEnabled|boolean|false|none|If a transaction is not reconciled within the `reconciliationWindowTtl` time, then the transaction is marked as `abandoned`.|
|reconciliationWindowTtl|integer|false|none|The time window (in seconds) allotted for a reconciliation to occur. If it is not reconciled in that time, then the transaction is marked as `abandoned`.|
|status|string|false|read-only|The gateway account's status.|
|sticky|boolean|false|none|Customer's payment instrument will "stick" to the gateway account for future transactions when enabled.|
|threeDSecure|boolean|false|none|True, if Gateway Account allows 3DSecure.|
|timeout|integer \| null|false|none|Gateway Account request timeout in seconds.|
|token|string|false|read-only|Gateway Account token.|
|updatedTime|object|false|none|Gateway Account updated time.|
|credentials|object|true|none|Gooney credentials object.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|_links|[[SelfLink](#schemaselflink) \| [OnBoardingUrlLink](#schemaonboardingurllink) \| [DynamicIpnLink](#schemadynamicipnlink) \| [StaticIpnLink](#schemastaticipnlink)]|false|read-only|The links related to resource.|
|acceptedCurrencies|[string]|true|none|Accepted currencies (array of the currency three letter codes).|
|acquirerName|object|false|none|none|
|additionalFilters|string|false|none|The additional filters are used to determine whether the gateway account can be selected for the transaction to be processed.<br>For example, the filter may put a maximum amount value. If the transaction is above that amount, this gateway account wouldn't be used.<br>This follows our standard filter format.<br>|
|approvalWindowTtl|integer|false|none|The time window (in seconds) allotted for approving an offsite transaction before it is automatically `abandoned`.|
|cityField|string|false|none|The gateway account's city field (also known as line 2 descriptor).|
|createdTime|object|false|none|Gateway Account created time.|
|dccForceCurrency|string|false|none|Force dynamic currency conversion to the specified currency on each sale.<br>Leave it empty to disable force DCC.<br>|
|dccMarkup|integer|false|none|Dynamic currency conversion markup in basis points.|
|descriptor|string|false|none|The gateway account's descriptor.|
|digitalWallets|[DigitalWallets](#schemadigitalwallets)|false|none|Configure which digital wallets are enabled.|
|dynamicDescriptor|boolean|false|none|True, if Gateway Account allows dynamic descriptor.|
|excludedDccQuoteCurrencies|[string]|false|none|Excluded Dynamic Currency Conversion Quote Currencies.|
|gatewayName|[GatewayName](#schemagatewayname)|true|none|The payment gateway name.|
|id|object|false|read-only|The gateway identifier string.|
|isDown|boolean|false|read-only|True if gateway is currently in downtime period.|
|merchantCategoryCode|string|false|none|The gateway account's merchant category code.|
|method|[PaymentMethod](#schemapaymentmethod)|true|none|The payment method.|
|monthlyLimit|number(double)|false|none|Monthly Limit.|
|organizationId|object|false|read-only|**Deprecated.** Organization ID.|
|paymentCardSchemes|[[PaymentCardBrand](#schemapaymentcardbrand)]|false|none|Accepted payment card brands.|
|reconciliationWindowEnabled|boolean|false|none|If a transaction is not reconciled within the `reconciliationWindowTtl` time, then the transaction is marked as `abandoned`.|
|reconciliationWindowTtl|integer|false|none|The time window (in seconds) allotted for a reconciliation to occur. If it is not reconciled in that time, then the transaction is marked as `abandoned`.|
|status|string|false|read-only|The gateway account's status.|
|sticky|boolean|false|none|Customer's payment instrument will "stick" to the gateway account for future transactions when enabled.|
|threeDSecure|boolean|false|none|True, if Gateway Account allows 3DSecure.|
|timeout|integer \| null|false|none|Gateway Account request timeout in seconds.|
|token|string|false|read-only|Gateway Account token.|
|updatedTime|object|false|none|Gateway Account updated time.|
|credentials|object|true|none|Greenbox credentials object.|
