```json
  "status": "confirmed",
  "subscriptionId": {}
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|_links|[[SelfLink](#schemaselflink)]|false|read-only|The links related to resource.|
|appliedInvoiceId|object|false|read-only|The identifier of the invoice where the cancellation fees or credits are applied.|
|canceledBy|string|false|none|Who did the cancellation.|
|canceledTime|string(date-time)|false|read-only|The cancellation time (when the status is confirmed which is by default unless specified "draft").|
|churnTime|string(date-time)|true|none|The time when the subscription will be deactivated.|
|createdTime|object|false|none|The time of resource creation (when it is posted).|
|description|string|false|none|Cancel reason description in free form.|
|id|object|false|read-only|Cancellation identifier.|
|lineItemSubtotal|number|false|read-only|Subtotal of the line items which will be added after the subscription's cancellation.|
|lineItems|object|false|none|Items to be added to the new invoice. Proration item is generated and added automatically.|
|prorated|boolean|false|none|Defines if the customer gets a pro-rata credit for the time remaining between `churnTime` and<br>subscription's next renewal time.<br>|
|proratedInvoiceId|object|false|read-only|Identifier of the invoice on which the cancellation proration is calculated.|
|reason|string|false|none|Cancellation reason.|
|status|string|false|none|"draft" defines that the cancellation isn't applied on an invoice and subscription but<br>can be inspected to see the charge.<br>"confirmed" will set a subscription to be canceled when the `churnTime` is reached.<br>"completed" is a read-only status which is set by the system when the churnTime is reached.<br>The cancellation may not be changed or deleted when the status is "completed".<br>|
|subscriptionId|object|true|none|Identifier of the canceled subscription order.|

|reason|did-not-use|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|effectiveTime|string(date-time)|false|none|The date from which the renewal time (for `reset` operations) and proration calculations are made.  If omitted, it will default to the current time.|
|items|[object]|true|none|none|
|keepTrial|boolean|false|none|If set to true and the subscription order has an active trial, it will use that trial further. Works with 'retain' renewalPolicy only.|
|preview|boolean|false|none|If set to true, it will not change the subscription.  It allows for a way to preview the changes that would be made to a subscription.|
|prorated|boolean|true|none|Whether or not to give a pro rata credit for the amount of time remaining between the `effectiveTime` and the end of the current period.<br>In addition, if the `renewalTime` is retained (by setting the `renewalPolicy` to `retain`), then a pro rata debit will occur as well,<br>for the amount between the `effectiveTime` and the `renewalTime` as a percentage of the normal period size.<br>|
|renewalPolicy|string|true|none|The value determines whether the subscription retains its current `renewalTime` or resets it to a newly calculated `renewalTime`.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|renewalPolicy|reset|
|renewalPolicy|retain|

|activationTime|object|false|none|Order activation time.|
|billingAddress|object \| null|false|none|Order billing address.|
|billingStatus|string|false|read-only|The billing status of the most recent invoice.  It may<br>help you determine if you should change the service status<br>such as suspending the service.<br>|
|couponIds|[string]|false|write-only|A list of coupons to redeem on the customer and restrict to this subscription.<br>Read more about [coupons here](https://docs.rebilly.com/docs/dashboard/marketing/coupons-and-discounts/).<br><br>This parameter respects the following logic:<br><br>- When not passed then applied coupons will not be changed.<br><br>- When empty array passed then all applied coupon redemptions will be canceled.<br><br>- When list of coupons is passed then not applied yet coupons will be applied, already applied coupons<br>will not change their state, applied coupons that are not presented in passed list will be canceled.<br><br>If list of applied coupons on pending order will be changed due to this param during update order,<br> Invoice for the order will be reissued.<br>|
|deliveryAddress|object \| null|false|none|Order delivery address.|
|id|object|false|read-only|The order identifier string.|
|initialInvoiceId|object|false|read-only|The initial invoice identifier string.|

|recentInvoiceId|object|false|read-only|Most recently issued invoice identifier string. It might not be `paid` yet.|
|voidTime|object|false|none|Order void time.|
|websiteId|object|true|none|The website identifier string.|
|autopay|boolean|false|none|Autopay determines if a payment attempt will be automatic.|
|endTime|object|false|none|Subscription end time.|
|inTrial|boolean|false|read-only|True if the subscription is currently in a trial period.|
|invoiceTimeShift|object \| null|false|none|You can shift issue time and due time of invoices for this subscription.<br>This setting overrides plan settings. To use plan settings, set `null`.<br>To use multiple plans in one subscription they all must have the same billing period,<br>this property allows to subscribe to different plans.<br>|
|isTrialOnly|boolean|false|none|Whether a subscription ends after a trial period. Recurring settings are ignored if it's `true`.|
|lineItemSubtotal|object|false|read-only|Subtotal of line items in this subscription (signed value). If credits exceed debits, it will be a negative number.|
|lineItems|object|false|read-only|Subscription line items which queue until the next renewal (or interim) invoice is issued for the subscription.|
|rebillNumber|integer|false|read-only|The current period number.|
|recurringInterval|object \| null|false|none|The recurring interval to override plan settings. To use plan settings, set `null`.<br>To use multiple plans in one subscription they all must have the same recurring period length,<br>this property allows to subscribe to different plans.<br>|
|renewalTime|string(date-time)|false|none|Subscription renewal time.|
|startTime|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|Subscription start time.  When the value is sent as null, it will use the current time. This value can't be in past more than one service period.|

|approvalWindowTtl|integer|false|none|The time window (in seconds) allotted for approving an offsite transaction before it is automatically `abandoned`.|

|createdTime|object|false|none|Gateway Account created time.|

|dccMarkup|integer|false|none|Dynamic currency conversion markup in basis points.|
|descriptor|string|false|none|The gateway account's descriptor.|
|digitalWallets|[DigitalWallets](#schemadigitalwallets)|false|none|Configure which digital wallets are enabled.|

|gatewayName|[GatewayName](#schemagatewayname)|true|none|The payment gateway name.|

|isDown|boolean|false|read-only|True if gateway is currently in downtime period.|

|reconciliationWindowEnabled|boolean|false|none|If a transaction is not reconciled within the `reconciliationWindowTtl` time, then the transaction is marked as `abandoned`.|
|reconciliationWindowTtl|integer|false|none|The time window (in seconds) allotted for a reconciliation to occur. If it is not reconciled in that time, then the transaction is marked as `abandoned`.|
|status|string|false|read-only|The gateway account's status.|
|sticky|boolean|false|none|Customer's payment instrument will "stick" to the gateway account for future transactions when enabled.|
|threeDSecure|boolean|false|none|True, if Gateway Account allows 3DSecure.|
|timeout|integer \| null|false|none|Gateway Account request timeout in seconds.|

The URL where a server-to-server POST notification will be sent.  It  will be sent when the
transaction's result is finalized after a timeout or an offsite interaction. Do not trust the
notification; follow with a GET request to confirm the result of the transaction. Please
respond with a 2xx HTTP status code, or we will reattempt the request again.
The 2 placeholders are available to use in this URI: `{id}` and `{result}`.

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|amount|number(double)|true|none|The transaction amount.|
|billingAddress|object \| null|false|none|Billing address. If not supplied, we use the billing address associated with the payment instrument, and then customer.|
|currency|object|true|none|none|
|customFields|[ResourceCustomFields](#schemaresourcecustomfields)|false|none|Custom Fields list as a map `{"custom field name": "custom field value", ...}`. The format must follow the saved format (see Custom Fields section for the formats).<br>|
|customerId|object|true|none|The customer identifier string.|
|description|string \| null|false|none|The payment description.|
|gatewayAccountId|object \| null|false|none|Rebilly will select the appropriate payment gateway account for the transaction based on the properties of the transaction and the `gateway-account-requested` event rules configurations. If you wish to prevent Rebilly from making the gateway account selection, you may supply a gateway account id here, and it will be used instead. Only use this field if you intend to override the settings.|
|invoiceIds|[[ResourceId](#schemaresourceid)]|false|none|The array of invoice identifiers.|
|isMerchantInitiated|boolean|false|none|True if the transaction was initiated by the merchant.|
|isProcessedOutside|boolean|false|none|True if transaction was processed outside Rebilly.|
|notificationUrl|string(uri) \| null|false|none|The URL where a server-to-server notification request type `POST` with a transaction payload will be sent when the transaction's result is finalized. Do not trust the notification; follow with a `GET` request to confirm the result of the transaction. Please respond with a `2xx` HTTP status code, or we will reattempt the request again. You may use `{id}` or `{result}` as placeholders in the URL and we will replace them with the transaction's id and result accordingly.<br>|
|paymentInstruction|object|false|none|Payment instruction. If not supplied, customer's default payment instrument will be used.|
|paymentInstrument|object|false|none|**Deprecated.**|

|websiteId|object|true|none|The website identifier string.|

If any existing `authorize` transactions are eligible, then they will be captured and the `sale` will be converted to a `capture` type.<br>|

|status|string|false|read-only|The gateway account's status.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|_links|[[SelfLink](#schemaselflink) \| [OnBoardingUrlLink](#schemaonboardingurllink) \| [DynamicIpnLink](#schemadynamicipnlink) \| [StaticIpnLink](#schemastaticipnlink)]|false|read-only|The links related to resource.|
|acceptedCurrencies|[string]|true|none|Accepted currencies (array of the currency three letter codes).|
|acquirerName|object|false|none|none|
|additionalFilters|string|false|none|The additional filters are used to determine whether the gateway account can be selected for the transaction to be processed.<br>For example, the filter may put a maximum amount value. If the transaction is above that amount, this gateway account wouldn't be used.<br>This follows our standard filter format.<br>|
|approvalWindowTtl|integer|false|none|The time window (in seconds) allotted for approving an offsite transaction before it is automatically `abandoned`.|
|cityField|string|false|none|The gateway account's city field (also known as line 2 descriptor).|
|createdTime|object|false|none|Gateway Account created time.|
|dccForceCurrency|string|false|none|Force dynamic currency conversion to the specified currency on each sale.<br>Leave it empty to disable force DCC.<br>|
|dccMarkup|integer|false|none|Dynamic currency conversion markup in basis points.|
|descriptor|string|false|none|The gateway account's descriptor.|
|digitalWallets|[DigitalWallets](#schemadigitalwallets)|false|none|Configure which digital wallets are enabled.|
|dynamicDescriptor|boolean|false|none|True, if Gateway Account allows dynamic descriptor.|
|excludedDccQuoteCurrencies|[string]|false|none|Excluded Dynamic Currency Conversion Quote Currencies.|
|gatewayName|[GatewayName](#schemagatewayname)|true|none|The payment gateway name.|
|id|object|false|read-only|The gateway identifier string.|
|isDown|boolean|false|read-only|True if gateway is currently in downtime period.|
|merchantCategoryCode|string|false|none|The gateway account's merchant category code.|
|method|[PaymentMethod](#schemapaymentmethod)|true|none|The payment method.|
|monthlyLimit|number(double)|false|none|Monthly Limit.|
|organizationId|object|false|read-only|**Deprecated.** Organization ID.|
|paymentCardSchemes|[[PaymentCardBrand](#schemapaymentcardbrand)]|false|none|Accepted payment card brands.|
|reconciliationWindowEnabled|boolean|false|none|If a transaction is not reconciled within the `reconciliationWindowTtl` time, then the transaction is marked as `abandoned`.|
|reconciliationWindowTtl|integer|false|none|The time window (in seconds) allotted for a reconciliation to occur. If it is not reconciled in that time, then the transaction is marked as `abandoned`.|
|status|string|false|read-only|The gateway account's status.|
|sticky|boolean|false|none|Customer's payment instrument will "stick" to the gateway account for future transactions when enabled.|
|threeDSecure|boolean|false|none|True, if Gateway Account allows 3DSecure.|
|timeout|integer \| null|false|none|Gateway Account request timeout in seconds.|
|token|string|false|read-only|Gateway Account token.|
|updatedTime|object|false|none|Gateway Account updated time.|
|credentials|object|true|none|VCreditos credentials object.|

If the transaction is above that amount, this gateway account wouldn't be used.<br>This follows our standard filter format.<br>|
|approvalWindowTtl|integer|false|none|The time window (in seconds) allotted for approving an offsite transaction before it is automatically `abandoned`.|
|cityField|string|false|none|The gateway account's city field (also known as line 2 descriptor).|
|createdTime|object|false|none|Gateway Account created time.|
|dccForceCurrency|string|false|none|Force dynamic currency conversion to the specified currency on each sale.<br>Leave it empty to disable force DCC.<br>|
|dccMarkup|integer|false|none|Dynamic currency conversion markup in basis points.|
|descriptor|string|false|none|The gateway account's descriptor.|
|digitalWallets|[DigitalWallets](#schemadigitalwallets)|false|none|Configure which digital wallets are enabled.|
|dynamicDescriptor|boolean|false|none|True, if Gateway Account allows dynamic descriptor.|
|excludedDccQuoteCurrencies|[string]|false|none|Excluded Dynamic Currency Conversion Quote Currencies.|

|id|object|false|read-only|The gateway identifier string.|
|isDown|boolean|false|read-only|True if gateway is currently in downtime period.|
|merchantCategoryCode|string|false|none|The gateway account's merchant category code.|
|method|[PaymentMethod](#schemapaymentmethod)|true|none|The payment method.|
|monthlyLimit|number(double)|false|none|Monthly Limit.|

|paymentCardSchemes|[[PaymentCardBrand](#schemapaymentcardbrand)]|false|none|Accepted payment card brands.|
|reconciliationWindowEnabled|boolean|false|none|If a transaction is not reconciled within the `reconciliationWindowTtl` time, then the transaction is marked as `abandoned`.|
|reconciliationWindowTtl|integer|false|none|The time window (in seconds) allotted for a reconciliation to occur. If it is not reconciled in that time, then the transaction is marked as `abandoned`.|
|status|string|false|read-only|The gateway account's status.|
|sticky|boolean|false|none|Customer's payment instrument will "stick" to the gateway account for future transactions when enabled.|
|threeDSecure|boolean|false|none|True, if Gateway Account allows 3DSecure.|
|timeout|integer \| null|false|none|Gateway Account request timeout in seconds.|
|token|string|false|read-only|Gateway Account token.|

|settings|object|true|none|WorldlineAtosFrankfurt settings.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|_links|[[SelfLink](#schemaselflink) \| [OnBoardingUrlLink](#schemaonboardingurllink) \| [DynamicIpnLink](#schemadynamicipnlink) \| [StaticIpnLink](#schemastaticipnlink)]|false|read-only|The links related to resource.|
|acceptedCurrencies|[string]|true|none|Accepted currencies (array of the currency three letter codes).|
|acquirerName|object|false|none|none|
|additionalFilters|string|false|none|The additional filters are used to determine whether the gateway account can be selected for the transaction to be processed.<br>For example, the filter may put a maximum amount value. If the transaction is above that amount, this gateway account wouldn't be used.<br>This follows our standard filter format.<br>|
|approvalWindowTtl|integer|false|none|The time window (in seconds) allotted for approving an offsite transaction before it is automatically `abandoned`.|
|cityField|string|false|none|The gateway account's city field (also known as line 2 descriptor).|
|createdTime|object|false|none|Gateway Account created time.|
|dccForceCurrency|string|false|none|Force dynamic currency conversion to the specified currency on each sale.<br>Leave it empty to disable force DCC.<br>|
|dccMarkup|integer|false|none|Dynamic currency conversion markup in basis points.|
|descriptor|string|false|none|The gateway account's descriptor.|
|digitalWallets|[DigitalWallets](#schemadigitalwallets)|false|none|Configure which digital wallets are enabled.|
|dynamicDescriptor|boolean|false|none|True, if Gateway Account allows dynamic descriptor.|
|excludedDccQuoteCurrencies|[string]|false|none|Excluded Dynamic Currency Conversion Quote Currencies.|
|gatewayName|[GatewayName](#schemagatewayname)|true|none|The payment gateway name.|
|id|object|false|read-only|The gateway identifier string.|
|isDown|boolean|false|read-only|True if gateway is currently in downtime period.|
|merchantCategoryCode|string|false|none|The gateway account's merchant category code.|
|method|[PaymentMethod](#schemapaymentmethod)|true|none|The payment method.|
|monthlyLimit|number(double)|false|none|Monthly Limit.|
|organizationId|object|false|read-only|**Deprecated.** Organization ID.|
|paymentCardSchemes|[[PaymentCardBrand](#schemapaymentcardbrand)]|false|none|Accepted payment card brands.|
|reconciliationWindowEnabled|boolean|false|none|If a transaction is not reconciled within the `reconciliationWindowTtl` time, then the transaction is marked as `abandoned`.|
|reconciliationWindowTtl|integer|false|none|The time window (in seconds) allotted for a reconciliation to occur. If it is not reconciled in that time, then the transaction is marked as `abandoned`.|
|status|string|false|read-only|The gateway account's status.|
|sticky|boolean|false|none|Customer's payment instrument will "stick" to the gateway account for future transactions when enabled.|
|threeDSecure|boolean|false|none|True, if Gateway Account allows 3DSecure.|
|timeout|integer \| null|false|none|Gateway Account request timeout in seconds.|
|token|string|false|read-only|Gateway Account token.|
|updatedTime|object|false|none|Gateway Account updated time.|
|credentials|object|true|none|Zimpler credentials object.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|_links|[[SelfLink](#schemaselflink) \| [OnBoardingUrlLink](#schemaonboardingurllink) \| [DynamicIpnLink](#schemadynamicipnlink) \| [StaticIpnLink](#schemastaticipnlink)]|false|read-only|The links related to resource.|
|acceptedCurrencies|[string]|true|none|Accepted currencies (array of the currency three letter codes).|
|acquirerName|object|false|none|none|
|additionalFilters|string|false|none|The additional filters are used to determine whether the gateway account can be selected for the transaction to be processed.<br>For example, the filter may put a maximum amount value. If the transaction is above that amount, this gateway account wouldn't be used.<br>This follows our standard filter format.<br>|
|approvalWindowTtl|integer|false|none|The time window (in seconds) allotted for approving an offsite transaction before it is automatically `abandoned`.|
|cityField|string|false|none|The gateway account's city field (also known as line 2 descriptor).|
|createdTime|object|false|none|Gateway Account created time.|
|dccForceCurrency|string|false|none|Force dynamic currency conversion to the specified currency on each sale.<br>Leave it empty to disable force DCC.<br>|
|dccMarkup|integer|false|none|Dynamic currency conversion markup in basis points.|
|descriptor|string|false|none|The gateway account's descriptor.|
|digitalWallets|[DigitalWallets](#schemadigitalwallets)|false|none|Configure which digital wallets are enabled.|
|dynamicDescriptor|boolean|false|none|True, if Gateway Account allows dynamic descriptor.|
|excludedDccQuoteCurrencies|[string]|false|none|Excluded Dynamic Currency Conversion Quote Currencies.|
|gatewayName|[GatewayName](#schemagatewayname)|true|none|The payment gateway name.|
|id|object|false|read-only|The gateway identifier string.|
|isDown|boolean|false|read-only|True if gateway is currently in downtime period.|
|merchantCategoryCode|string|false|none|The gateway account's merchant category code.|
|method|[PaymentMethod](#schemapaymentmethod)|true|none|The payment method.|
|monthlyLimit|number(double)|false|none|Monthly Limit.|
|organizationId|object|false|read-only|**Deprecated.** Organization ID.|
|paymentCardSchemes|[[PaymentCardBrand](#schemapaymentcardbrand)]|false|none|Accepted payment card brands.|
|reconciliationWindowEnabled|boolean|false|none|If a transaction is not reconciled within the `reconciliationWindowTtl` time, then the transaction is marked as `abandoned`.|
|reconciliationWindowTtl|integer|false|none|The time window (in seconds) allotted for a reconciliation to occur. If it is not reconciled in that time, then the transaction is marked as `abandoned`.|
|status|string|false|read-only|The gateway account's status.|
|sticky|boolean|false|none|Customer's payment instrument will "stick" to the gateway account for future transactions when enabled.|
|threeDSecure|boolean|false|none|True, if Gateway Account allows 3DSecure.|
|timeout|integer \| null|false|none|Gateway Account request timeout in seconds.|
|token|string|false|read-only|Gateway Account token.|
|updatedTime|object|false|none|Gateway Account updated time.|
|credentials|object|true|none|ezyEFT credentials object.|

<h2 id="tocS_volume">volume</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemavolume"></a>
<a id="schema_volume"></a>
<a id="tocSvolume"></a>
<a id="tocsvolume"></a>

```json
{
  "formula": "fixed-fee",
  "brackets": [
    {
      "maxQuantity": 1,
      "price": 99.95
    }
  ]
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|formula|string|true|none|The price formula determines what algorithm is used to calculate the invoice price based on a few factors,<br>- the quantity in the order (which may be variable if usage pricing, otherwise determined when creating the order)<br>- the price brackets data<br><br>To determine which formula is correct, please see the price formula documentation.<br>|
|brackets|[object]|true|none|The price brackets, along with the price formula,<br>is used to calculate the amount to charge for the product on this plan on the invoice.<br><br>The "volume" example:<br><br>Price per apple \| Max quantity \| Description<br>----------------\|--------------\|------------<br>$5              \| 1            \| 1<br>$4              \| 5            \| 2 to 5<br>$3              \| null         \| 6 or more<br><br>If someone bought 1 apple, it would be $5.<br><br>If someone bought 2 apples, it would be $8. For 2 to 5 apples, the price is $4 per apple.<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|formula|fixed-fee|
|formula|flat-rate|
|formula|stairstep|
|formula|tiered|
|formula|volume|
